answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to the temperatures at which food can be **accepted during receiving**:

---

## 🌡️ Food Receiving Temperature Guidelines

### ❄️ Cold TCS (Time/Temperature Control for Safety) Foods
- **Cold TCS foods** (such as fish) must be received at **41°F (5°C) or lower**, unless otherwise specified.

### 🔥 Hot TCS Foods
- **Hot TCS food** must be received at **135°F (57°C) or higher.**

### 🦪 Live Shellfish (Oysters, Mussels, Clams, Scallops)
- Live shellfish must be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C)** and an internal temperature **no greater than 50°F (10°C)**.
- They must be cooled to **41°F (5°C) or below within four hours** of receiving.

### 🦪 Shucked Shellfish
- Shucked shellfish must be received at **45°F (7°C) or lower.**

### 🥛 Milk & Shell Eggs
- Milk and eggs can be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower**, but should be refrigerated at or below **41°F (5°C)** upon receiving.

### 🥚 Shell Eggs
- Shell eggs must be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower.**

### 🧊 Frozen Foods
- Frozen food **should be frozen solid** when received.
- Look for signs of thawing and refreezing, such as **ice crystals in the box, fluids or water stains on the case, or frozen liquids** on or in the packages.

---

## 🚫 When to Reject Food
- If food temperatures do not meet requirements, or if TCS food shows **evidence of previous temperature abuse**, do not accept the food, or discard the products.
- Do not accept food that is **missing use-by or expiration dates** from the manufacturer.
- Reject food and nonfood items if packaging has **tears, holes, or punctures**. Also reject cans with labels that are not intact or have **bulging/swollen ends, rust, or dents.**

---

## 🌡️ The Temperature Danger Zone
The **danger zone** is the temperature range where bacteria thrive: **41°F to 135°F**. Within this range, pathogens like *Salmonella*, *E. coli*, and *Listeria* multiply rapidly — bacteria can **double in number every 20 minutes** when food sits at these temperatures.

---

### Quick Reference Summary Table

| Food Type | Acceptable Receiving Temp |
|---|---|
| Cold TCS Foods (meat, poultry, fish) | 41°F (5°C) or lower |
| Hot TCS Foods | 135°F (57°C) or higher |
| Live Shellfish | 45°F (7°C) air / 50°F (10°C) internal |
| Shucked Shellfish | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Milk | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Shell Eggs | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Frozen Foods | Frozen solid (0°F / -18°C) |
